reasons.notes_match_photos: Adjuster notes list front bumper, bonnet and left headlight; photo captions cover exactly those areas.
reasons.settlement_path: Repair estimate of EUR 6200 is about 73% of the EUR 8500 market value, near or above common total-loss thresholds, but no policy threshold is given so repair and total loss both remain plausible.
reasons.documentation_quality: Itemized repair estimate, adjuster notes and captioned photos cover the loss well, though driver statement, third-party details and odometer/VIN evidence are absent.
